title: Long-memory Markov chains with power-law intensities
summary: We introduce a self-exciting point process with power-law intensity dynamics that admits a finite-dimensional Markovian state representation. The model is constructed to preserve the local jump and slope update structure of power-law Hawkes processes, while replacing global history dependence with a nonlinear Markov chain governing the intensity dynamics. Within a general state-space framework, we establish irreducibility, aperiodicity, and the T-chain property under mild regularity conditions on the inter-arrival time distribution.
